text: Cross-module references shall obey exports/import locks. Ordinary aux/section/continuation labels shall remain module-private. A cross-module aux helper shall require a validated runtime contract/binding, exact callable descriptor/opcode/ordered type and integer arguments. Specialization shall use symbolic type keys until final IDs.
